description: Golden questions for three invented meetings in samples/meetings (see samples/SOURCES.md). 'expected' lists turns that answer the question: 'meeting' is the file, 'speaker' and 'atMs' (milliseconds as written in the file) locate the turn, and every 'quote' is verbatim from that turn; { notes: true } means the notes of the meeting also answer it. 'scope' restricts the chat to those files, 'filters' names what the question asks for (a speaker, a stretch of time). 'notes' is what a good set of notes holds for each meeting.

questions.question: What did the team finally decide to ship in Q4?

expected.speaker: Priya
expected.quote: we ship dark mode in Q4 and offline sync moves to Q1

questions.answer: Dark mode ships in Q4 and offline sync moves to Q1. The earlier plan to make offline sync the Q4 headline feature was dropped.

questions.question: Why was offline sync moved to Q1?

expected.speaker: Marcus
expected.quote: six weeks of work for two engineers, not the three weeks we assumed

expected.speaker: Priya
expected.quote: shipping it in Q4 means starting right now with no slack

questions.answer: Marcus found it is six weeks of work for two engineers, not three weeks, so shipping it in Q4 would leave no slack.

questions.question: Who will have the onboarding mockups ready, and by when?

expected.speaker: Lena
expected.quote: I'll have the onboarding mockups ready by the 25th

questions.answer: Lena, by September 25th.

questions.question: Who is writing the offline sync estimate and when is it due?

expected.speaker: Marcus
expected.quote: I'll write the offline sync estimate and send it to everyone by Friday

questions.answer: Marcus, by Friday.

questions.question: What is Tomás going to do about the customers who asked for offline sync?

expected.speaker: Tomás
expected.quote: I'll collect quotes from the customers who asked for offline sync

questions.answer: He will collect their quotes for the Q1 planning, with no deadline.

questions.question: Who is going to update the public roadmap page?

expected.speaker: Priya
expected.quote: Somebody needs to update that

expected.speaker: Priya
expected.quote: we'll figure out who does it

questions.answer: Nobody was named: Marco and Lena have no access, and Priya said they would figure out who does it.

expected.speaker: Marcus

questions.answer: Marcus said it is six weeks of work for two engineers, not the three weeks assumed.

questions.question: What does Tomás say customers are asking for?

questions.question: Was a discount for annual plans approved?

expected.speaker: Priya
expected.quote: Let's revisit it next month

expected.speaker: Tomás
expected.quote: I would suggest a discount for annual plans

questions.answer: No. Tomás suggested about fifteen percent, but Priya did not want to decide pricing without finance and postponed it to next month.

expected.speaker: Marcus

expected.speaker: Lena

expected.quote: the public roadmap page still says offline sync is coming in Q4

questions.answer: Priya noted the public roadmap page still says offline sync is coming in Q4 and nobody had access to update it.

expected.quote: I'll need the dark mode build two weeks before the release

expected.speaker: Lena
expected.quote: will the dark mode launch need a new logo variant

questions.answer: Lena asked about a logo variant, and Marco said he needs the dark mode build two weeks before the release.

questions.answer: Not yet. Marcus wants one in November, and Priya said to confirm after the dark mode release.

expected.speaker: Marcus

questions.answer: Twenty-five minutes.

questions.question: What caused the checkout outage?

expected.speaker: Erik

questions.answer: An expired certificate on the gateway proxy; it expired at 21:40.

questions.question: How long was checkout down?

questions.answer: Fifty-two minutes. Dana's first estimate of forty minutes was corrected.

expected.quote: Customers told us

questions.answer: Dana, with no date promised.

questions.answer: They lost twenty-five minutes looking for the person who held the renewal credentials.

questions.question: What did Dana say about alerts?

expected.quote: The first alert fired at 22:00

expected.speaker: Dana
expected.quote: We should get warned fourteen days before any certificate expires

questions.answer: The first alert came at 22:00, eighteen minutes in, because monitoring only checked the health endpoint; she wants a warning fourteen days before any certificate expires.

expected.quote: the payment gateway started returning TLS errors

questions.answer: Gus opened the review and Dana described how the gateway started returning TLS errors at 21:42.
